newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex suffers oil spill in Veracruz - reports.
newsitem.headline: Pemex suffers oil spill in Veracruz - reports.

text.p: State oil company Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) suffered an oil spill in the eastern coastal state of Veracruz, media reports and environmental groups said.
Mexican radio station Radio Red said on Wednesday the spill took place inland near the city of Poza Rica, Veracruz, some 220 kilometers east of the capital.
Late on Tuesday, the Mexican environmental organization Group of 100 also reported the spill, saying it was "large" and had entered a nearby river system
The Group of 100, Mexico's best-known environmental group, said the spill had covered between 24 and 30 kilometers of the Tecolutla river, which empties into the Gulf of Mexico.
Pemex officials were not available for comment. The state company had not reported any spill, which Radio Red said took place several days ago.
Radio Red and the Group of 100 said local villagers notified the environmental group of the spill after dead fish, black with oil, began turning up in the Tecolutla river.
